title: Uncertainty-aware damage identification in short-span bridges via physics-informed variational autoencoder
abstract: arXiv:2607.05025v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Vibration-based damage identification in civil infrastructure is a challenging, ill-posed inverse problem due to measurement noise, sparse sensor arrays, and modeling errors. While deep learning is powerful for system identification, deterministic approaches lack reliable uncertainty quantification and can yield physically inconsistent results. This work proposes a probabilistic Scientific Machine Learning framework for structural health monitoring: a physics-informed Gaussian copula variational autoencoder. The methodology introduces two main contributions. First, a numerical eigenvalue solver is embedded directly into the variational autoencoder as its decoder, which replaces data-driven surrogates, ensures that every posterior sample satisfies the governing equations of structural dynamics, and reduces the number of trainable parameters. translated_title: 基于物理信息变分自编码器的短跨桥梁不确定性感知损伤识别
translated_abstract: 土木基础设施中基于振动的损伤识别是一个具有挑战性的不适定逆问题，其原因在于测量噪声、稀疏的传感器布置以及建模误差。虽然深度学习在系统识别方面功能强大，但确定性方法缺乏可靠的不确定性量化，且可能产生物理上不一致的结果。本工作提出了一种用于结构健康监测的概率型科学机器学习框架：物理信息高斯copula变分自编码器。该方法引入了两项主要贡献。首先，将数值特征值求解器直接嵌入变分自编码器作为其解码器，从而取代数据驱动的代理模型，确保每个后验样本均满足结构动力学的控制方程，并减少了可训练参数的数量。其次，采用高斯copula描述刚度因子的后验分布，以捕捉参数之间的相关性（原文此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出将数值特征值求解器直接嵌入变分自编码器解码器并利用高斯copula刻画刚度因子后验分布的物理信息框架，实现了短跨桥梁振动损伤识别中可靠的不确定性量化与物理一致性保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a physics-informed Gaussian copula variational autoencoder that embeds a numerical eigenvalue solver as its decoder and models the posterior of stiffness factors with a Gaussian copula, enabling reliable uncertainty quantification and physical consistency for vibration-based damage identification in short-span bridges.
